fusions.name: Circle and Snap
fusions.desc: Bites for 14 damage, leaving the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Feeding Pass
fusions.desc: A flurry of bites hits every enemy within 3 tiles for 7 damage. Costs 6% of your maximum health, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Blood in the Water
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Scent Trail
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 4 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
